Terrible service. I was assisted by Leonor, who had absolutely no idea about customer service. The treatment she received was deplorable. Their MercadoPago system wasn't working because it was down, and they didn't notify me of this problem beforehand. Then she proceeded to treat me terribly while I was trying to find another payment method. She made no attempt to resolve the issue and was very unwilling to help. I didn't even receive an apology for the problem, which they knew they were having and which wasn't my fault. Very poor service.
